audience: sales and account teams who keep their customers, leads and notes in PerfectView

useCases.title: Review a relation and its latest notes
useCases.text: Search relations by name to find the right one. Then read its details and the notes written on it.

useCases.title: Add a follow-up note to a relation
useCases.text: Find the relation by name, then add the follow-up. The note is saved at once and cannot be undone through this tool.

useCases.title: Look up how a person links to an organisation
useCases.text: Search the relationships by name, such as an employee or contact at a company. Read one relationship with its custom field values.

useCases.title: Read custom fields before reading a relation
useCases.text: List the field definitions for one kind of relation, such as organisations. Then read a relation with its custom field values.

useCases.title: Check the product list before writing a note
useCases.text: List the products and services defined in the database. Use their names when you write a note about a deal.
